text:
incident-bot: [PAGE] streaming-inference-prod p99 latency alert triggered (metric: request_latency_p99 > 1.2s) at 2026-03-15T16:12:31Z. Paging #incidents and oncall.

Sara: I'm oncall, grabbing context. p95 looks normal but p99 is ~1.8s and streaming sessions showing micro-stalls. Any immediate infra flags?

Raj: checking telemetry. There's a spike of long-tail stalls originating from node gpu-22.cluster-prod. Token generation stalls align with repeated KV cache refill attempts.

Mei: ssh'ed into gpu-22, running quick health:
```
$ ssh infra@gpu-22
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,memory.used,compute_mode,driver_version,ecc.errors.current --format=csv
45 C, 95 %, 15872 MiB, Default, 535.86, 23
```
Mei: ECC correctable counters are higher than baseline and kernel logs show PCIe AER events. Temperature okay but utilization pegged.

Alex: that pattern previously correlated with transient ECC bursts causing the runtime to stall while hardware corrects errors. Also seeing repeated small kernel preemptions.

Chris: support reports one customer (enterprise-labs) with chunked responses and two timeouts during a 12:08 heavy stream. CS tickets: CS-4999, CS-5001. Noting increased TTL reconnects.

Sara: immediate plan: (1) cordon gpu-22 to avoid new allocations, (2) evacuate long-running streaming pods gracefully, (3) enable route fallback to standby pool, (4) drop batch size for the hot pool. Mei/Raj start cordon/drain.

Raj: initiating cordon/drain.
```
$ k8s node cordon gpu-22
$ k8s drain --timeout=45s --ignore-daemonsets gpu-22
```
Raj: drain progressing, ~60% pods moved.

Mei: starting graceful handoff for active streams, LB draining showing session transfer.

Sara: routing change ready? Alex, can you flip a short-lived policy to route /v1/stream/* to fallback-pool?

Alex: applying routing override now.
```
PATCH /routing/overrides
{ "match": "/v1/stream/*", "target": "fallback-pool", "ttl": "15m", "reason": "hardware-fallback-gpu-22" }
```
Alex: override accepted. Telemetry shows ~30% traffic moved within 40s. p99 trending down to 1.0s.

incident-bot: [NOTIFY] routing override deployed by Alex at 2026-03-15T16:15:10Z.

Raj: also lowering STREAM_BATCH_MAX=800 for the hot pool to reduce per-GPU queueing. Pushing config now.

Mei: drain finished. Node marked unschedulable. Uploading debug bundle to s3://infra-incidents/pm/4920001111/gpu-22/.

Mei: grabbed dmesg excerpt: 
```
[kernel] GPU ECC: corrected 0xF3 at 0x1b2c... ts=16:12:25
[kernel] PCIe AER: upstream fatal error, resetting link
[runtime] kv-cache refill burst for model/stream-v2 -> stall detected
```

Chris: CS note sent to affected customers: "We're routing your sessions to a fallback pool while we investigate a hardware issue on a GPU node; you may see slight latency changes but progress should continue. We'll update in 30 minutes." Customer reply: appreciate quick action. :thumbsup:

Sara: good. Raj, ensure autoscaler won't reprovision gpu-22 into the pool automatically.

Raj: autoscaler cooldown in place, also set node pool autoscaling disabled for this pool until we clear. Confirmed.

Alex: enabling prefix caching for hot prefixes for 10m to reduce token churn and token pressure. This should help tail.

incident-bot: [METRIC] p95=330ms p99=720ms at 2026-03-15T16:18:02Z. Streaming stall count down 70%.

Mei: opening vendor ticket VEND-984 with logs and asked for hardware diagnostics and ECC history. Requested vendor run GPU diagnostic and provide EET for replacement if deemed flaky.

Sara: interim engineering actions: (A) keep gpu-22 cordoned, (B) watch p99 for 30m, (C) if vendor indicates unrepairable -> RMA GPU and reprovision node, (D) add alerting rule to fire earlier on ECC correctable burst. Raj/Alex own automation changes.

Raj: I'll add a short-term alert: if ECC correctable errors > 5 in 60s -> page infra oncall AND trigger automatic cordon for that node.

Alex: I'll prototype a stall-based circuit breaker in routing: if a route observes >3 stalls in 2m, route traffic to fallback for 5m automatically. Will put behind feature flag.

Mei: vendor acknowledged ticket VEND-984, ETA 2-4h for deeper analysis. Provided NVSMI dumps and PCIe logs.

Chris: CS will post a customer-facing incident update at +30m and an internal impact summary to PM-492 and link this thread.

Sara: tayler will take handoff at 17:00 UTC. tayler, action items: monitor p99 and vendor ticket, ensure fallback remains active until node healthy.

Tayler: taking handoff. I'll watch for re-escalation and confirm vendor outcome.

Sara: resolving immediate page since condition cleared below threshold and fallback in place, but keeping incident channel open for vendor updates. Thanks team.

incident-bot: [RESOLVE] streaming-inference-prod p99 alert cleared at 2026-03-15T16:22:09Z (condition below threshold).

Sara: follow-up: create PM ticket PM-492 with timeline, customers affected, metrics and recommended changes (ECC burst alerts, auto-cordon, route CB). Assign to Raj/Mei/Alex for fixes and postmortem. Chris will draft customer summary.

-- end of thread --
